nodes.name: Notion: Get Database Pages
nodes.notes: Attach your Notion credential. Filter Status = Ready to publish.

nodes.name: Notion: Get Blocks
nodes.notes: Auth: use your Notion credential (predefined) or a Bearer header. Header Notion-Version required.

nodes.name: Ollama: Proofread
nodes.notes: Local Ollama chat API, no auth. If n8n is in Docker, change localhost to host.docker.internal or the host LAN IP, and run Ollama with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0. Set model to your `ollama list` tag.

nodes.name: Publish mode
nodes.notes: Set mode to 'auto' (commit to master) or 'pr' (open a Pull Request).

nodes.name: GitHub: Commit to master
nodes.notes: AUTO mode. Auth: GitHub PAT via Bearer header/credential. For updates to an existing file, GET its sha first and add it to the body.

nodes.name: Notion: Mark Published
nodes.notes: Only wired for the AUTO branch here. For PR mode, mark 'Pending review' instead and flip to Published on merge.
